title: Anomaly Detection Add-on Configuration
description: Operator-tunable detector thresholds and the per-host series cap for the edge anomaly add-on. All fields optional; omitted fields keep the detector defaults (window 300, min_samples 30, n_sigma 3.0, confirm_slots 5).

managed.title: Managed detector configuration
managed.description: Settings projected by ServiceRadar core from the Anomaly Detection settings singleton. Operator-explicit top-level params take precedence over these managed defaults.

min_samples.title: Minimum samples before a baseline is ready

confirm_slots.title: Consecutive breaches required to confirm an anomaly

metric_denylist.title: Managed metric denylist
metric_denylist.description: Metric names that should not produce detector findings. An empty list explicitly disables the denylist.

min_samples.title: Minimum samples before a baseline is ready
min_samples.description: Must be less than or equal to window_size; otherwise the detector window can never warm up.

confirm_slots.title: Consecutive breaches required to confirm an anomaly

max_series.title: Maximum tracked series per host (memory bound)

min_std_floor.title: Global absolute dispersion floor (metric units)
min_std_floor.description: Optional fleet-wide floor on the standard deviation the z-score divides by, raised before scoring so a near-constant series cannot turn a trivial wiggle into a huge z-score. Applied as a max with each series' built-in per-class floor, so it only ever tightens (never weakens a saturation gauge's safe default). Omit to keep built-in defaults (0 for non-gauges; the cpu/mem/disk gauge defaults otherwise).

min_cv.title: Global relative dispersion floor (coefficient of variation)
min_cv.description: Optional fleet-wide relative floor: the effective dispersion is at least min_cv * |mean|, so a high-magnitude series with proportionally small jitter is also tamed. Applied as a max with each series' built-in per-class floor (only ever tightens). Omit to keep built-in defaults.

cusum_k.title: CUSUM slack (reference value k, in sigma)
cusum_k.description: Only a standardized deviation beyond k accumulates. The standard tabular-CUSUM value 0.5 (paired with h=8.0) detects a sustained ~1-sigma shift with a lower false-open rate.

cusum_h.title: CUSUM decision interval (h, the alarm threshold)
cusum_h.description: An accumulator past h is a sustained-drift alarm. Expected samples to alarm for a persistent shift d (in sigma) is about h / (d - k). Default 8.0.

h_confirm_mult.title: CUSUM confirmation multiplier
h_confirm_mult.description: After an accumulator crosses h, drift enters pending state and emits only if the same accumulator reaches h * h_confirm_mult within drift_confirm_window samples.

drift_confirm_window.title: Drift confirmation window (samples)
drift_confirm_window.description: Number of samples after a pending drift latch may reach the confirmation threshold before decaying back to zero silently.

drift_min_effect.title: Minimum drift effect size (sigma)
drift_min_effect.description: Minimum estimated sustained shift before a CUSUM alarm emits a drift finding. The estimate is k + S/N, so the finding score is bounded by effect size rather than the raw unbounded accumulator.

drift_clear_slots.title: Drift clear confirmation window (samples)
drift_clear_slots.description: Consecutive recovered samples required before an open drift episode emits a clear.

drift_adopt_after_samples.title: Drift adoption window (samples)
drift_adopt_after_samples.description: Samples after drift open before a persistent non-saturated new level is adopted as the baseline and cleared.

spike_adopt_after_samples.title: Rolling-spike adoption window (samples)
spike_adopt_after_samples.description: Samples after a confirmed rolling spike opens before a stable non-saturated level is adopted into the rolling baseline and cleared.

episode_update_interval_secs.title: Episode heartbeat interval (seconds)
episode_update_interval_secs.description: Minimum interval between still-open drift heartbeat updates.

reopen_cooldown_secs.title: Episode reopen cooldown (seconds)
reopen_cooldown_secs.description: Re-opens within this interval after a clear reuse the previous drift episode identity with reopen_count incremented.

anchor_max_age_secs.title: CUSUM anchor maximum age (seconds)
anchor_max_age_secs.description: Maximum age for an idle always-on rolling CUSUM anchor before it refreshes to the current rolling window.

critical_min_duration_secs.title: Critical minimum duration (seconds)
critical_min_duration_secs.description: Minimum episode duration before a High anomaly can become Critical.

drift_escalate_after_secs.title: Drift escalation delay (seconds)
drift_escalate_after_secs.description: Minimum open drift duration before a Medium drift episode can escalate to High.

emission_cooldown_secs.title: Emission cooldown (seconds)
emission_cooldown_secs.description: Minimum interval between non-clear anomaly emissions for one detector series. Clear transitions are exempt.

emission_budget_per_tick.title: Emission budget per tick
emission_budget_per_tick.description: Maximum non-clear anomaly records emitted per metric-feed tick before remaining transitions are accounted in an anomaly_emission_shed rollup.

emission.title: Emission governance
emission.description: Nested replacement for the legacy flat emission keys. When both forms are present, nested values take precedence.

cooldown_secs.title: Emission cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_secs.description: Minimum interval between non-clear anomaly emissions for one detector series. Clear transitions are exempt.

budget_per_tick.title: Emission budget per tick
budget_per_tick.description: Maximum non-clear anomaly records emitted per metric-feed tick before remaining transitions are accounted in an anomaly_emission_shed rollup.

episode_update_interval_secs.title: Episode heartbeat interval (seconds)
episode_update_interval_secs.description: Minimum interval between still-open drift heartbeat updates.

reopen_cooldown_secs.title: Episode reopen cooldown (seconds)
reopen_cooldown_secs.description: Re-opens within this interval after a clear reuse the previous drift episode identity with reopen_count incremented.

metric_denylist.title: Metric denylist
metric_denylist.description: Metric names that should not produce detector findings. Omit to use the built-in denylist; set an empty list to disable it explicitly.

metric_classes.title: Per-metric-class detector overrides
metric_classes.description: Additive per-class configuration surface projected from core. Supported class keys include cpu, memory, disk, interface, icmp, and other; unknown class keys are accepted for forward compatibility but must use the same object shape.

severity_bands.description: Optional per-class rolling-score thresholds; accepts numeric or numeric-string medium and high values.

metric_feed.title: Local metric feed subscription
metric_feed.description: Controls which local agent metric sources are streamed into the add-on. The default subscribes only to sysmon and SNMP metrics; ICMP and generic timeseries batches must be opted in explicitly.

checkpoint_path.title: Restart checkpoint file path
checkpoint_path.description: Local path the add-on atomically persists its per-series baselines + counter state to, so a restart re-warms instead of cold-starting (which would storm false positives while windows refill). Unset disables checkpointing.

checkpoint_max_age_secs.title: Checkpoint staleness bound (seconds)
checkpoint_max_age_secs.description: On restart, a series whose last reading is older than this is not reseeded (a stale baseline would mis-score current traffic). Default 21600 (6h).

scoring_stale_after_secs.title: Scoring liveness stale threshold (seconds)
scoring_stale_after_secs.description: Once scoring has started, health degrades if no metric-feed frame finishes scoring within this age. Tune to match the expected local metric feed cadence. Default 300 (5m).

max_baselines.title: Maximum delivered baselines accepted
max_baselines.description: Caps the number of delivered seasonal baselines the add-on accepts from one config payload. Omit for no local cap.

min_bucket_samples.title: Minimum trusted samples per seasonal bucket
min_bucket_samples.description: Written by core with the delivered baseline so core eligibility and edge trust use the same history gate.

seasonal_baselines.title: Per-series hour-of-week seasonal baselines
seasonal_baselines.description: Optional central hour-of-week baselines pushed core->edge so the detector deseasonalizes against the long-horizon profile instead of only its short rolling window. Keyed by the canonical '<device_uid>|<metric_name>' (central's series:uid profile keyspace), so a delivered baseline resolves at scoring even though the per-series detector key is finer. Each series carries up to 168 (dow, hod) buckets with a robust median center and dispersion scale. Omitted keeps every series on the rolling-only path. Built by core from the seasonal hour-of-week profile (stats:profile_hour_of_week).

encoding.title: Baseline encoding
encoding.description: Optional producer hint. 'compact_168_f32' means centers/scales/sample_counts are 168-slot hour-of-week arrays.

scale.title: Robust dispersion (metric units) for this bucket

centers.title: Compact hour-of-week centers
centers.description: Optional 168-slot array indexed dow*24+hod. Null slots mean no delivered baseline for that hour.

scales.title: Compact hour-of-week scales
scales.description: Optional 168-slot array indexed dow*24+hod. Null slots mean no delivered baseline for that hour.

sample_counts.title: Compact hour-of-week sample counts
sample_counts.description: Optional 168-slot array indexed dow*24+hod. Zero means no delivered baseline for that hour.
